title: Machine learning provides evidence that stroke risk is not linear: The non-linear Framingham stroke risk score.
summary: An optimal classification tree using Framingham cohorts yields nonlinear stroke-risk profiles and is compared with the revised Framingham score on held-out cohorts.
ai_technology: tree model trained on 14,195 Framingham offspring examinations; paper evaluates held-out Framingham and external cohorts, with calibration and discrimination comparisons. Retrospective risk-model evidence, not prospective clinical utility.
